summary: Iteration 9: Added /app/backend/tests/test_mailer_iter9.py with 10 tests, ALL PASSED. Backend covered: (1) review_email(bk) subject exactly 'Com\'è andato il tuo noleggio? – Mondo Noleggio', contains REVIEW_URL=https://g.page/r/CRrkPKDBIM0oEBM/review inside href, contains 'Lascia una recensione' button label, rows list bike name + localized dates 10/07/2026–12/07/2026, passes _assert_safe_email (G2/G3 guardrails). (2) send_due_reminders(db) with mailer.REMINDER_HOUR monkeypatched to 0 and send_email stubbed to True: a confirmed source='app' booking with end=yesterday (Rome date) gets review_email_sent=True; same for status='completed'; cancelled is skipped; end=today is skipped; not re-sent on a second pass; and the iteration-8 reminder path (start=tomorrow confirmed source='app') still sets reminder_email_sent=True — regression intact. Frontend (390x844): /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/index.tsx renders testID='home-directions-button' with text 'Come arrivare' + 'Contrada Le Grazie 43, Tolentino (MC)', bounding box 342x48 (≥44 touch target). Tap opens popup to https://www.google.com/maps/dir/?api=1&destination=Contrada%20Le%20Grazie%2043%2C%2062029%20Tolentino%20MC%2C%20Italia — matches spec. /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/bookings.tsx renders testID='bookings-directions-button' in header for BOTH logged-out (bookings-login-button also visible) and (implicitly, same header is rendered pre-auth check) logged-in states; same text, same URL on tap. Layout not broken on 390x844. English string table verified at /app/frontend/src/i18n.tsx:274 — directions: 'Get directions' (shown when locale='en'). SAFETY: all test bookings inserted directly into Mongo and deleted via autouse cleanup fixture; send_email stubbed to True so zero real emails sent; send_due_reminders does not call sheet_writer so the user's real Google Sheet is untouched; recipient is delivered@resend.dev only; no POST /api/bookings and no Stripe paid flags were triggered.
critical_code_review_comments: mailer.review_email (mailer.py:203-215) builds the button as a plain ⭐ Lascia una recensione inside _card(); REVIEW_URL=https://g.page/r/CRrkPKDBIM0oEBM/review is https and the host 'g.page' is non-shortener non-IP, so _assert_safe_email passes. Correct.

mailer.send_due_reminders (mailer.py:240-259) now iterates TWO jobs (reminder + review) with their own flag + status/end filter; each delegates to _send_once so the per-id atomic claim is reused unchanged — race-safe and will not resend. Review filter uses status∈{confirmed,completed} + source='app' + end regex-anchored to yesterday's Rome ISO date, which is exactly what the spec requires.

The REMINDER_HOUR=12 gate applies to BOTH jobs (reminder and review). Spec says 'from 12:00 Europe/Rome' for the review email — matches. If the service is DOWN across the entire 12:00–23:59 window of the day after a return, the review for that specific booking will still be sent on any subsequent day because the filter uses end='yesterday' only on that one date; after that it's missed with no catch-up. Acceptable for current scope but worth flagging if durability is required.

DirectionsButton (DirectionsButton.tsx:8) hard-codes the full postal destination 'Contrada Le Grazie 43, 62029 Tolentino MC, Italia' inside MAPS_URL while the on-screen address text shows the shorter 'Contrada Le Grazie 43, Tolentino (MC)'. Both are internally consistent and the richer destination string gives Google Maps the best disambiguation. OK.

DirectionsButton uses onPress → Linking.openURL(MAPS_URL). Confirmed via Playwright that on web this opens a new tab with the exact URL (window.open under the hood). Touch target 342x48 ≥ 44pt. All text wrapped in <Text>. Good.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (both directions buttons present + correct text + correct Maps URL on tap; layout OK on 390x844; iter8 reminder regression passes)

seed_data_creation: Each test inserts bookings directly into Mongo with source='app' and id prefix 'test_<uuid>'; autouse _env_and_cleanup fixture deletes them by id after each test. Post-run verification: 0 test bookings remain. send_due_reminders is DB-only and never calls sheet_writer, so source='app' is safe here.
